For the pentagon above, determine the measure of the exterior angle of $∠A.$
question.worked_solution:
Note that the measure of the exterior angle at $C$ is ${180}^{∘}-(4x-{1}^{∘})={181}^{∘}-4x,$ and the measure of the exterior angle at $E$ is ${180}^{∘}-{86}^{∘}={94}^{∘}.$

Since the sum of the exterior angles of a polygon is ${360}^{∘},$  we have

$$
\begin{aligned}(2x+{1}^{∘})+(2x+{14}^{∘})+({181}^{∘}-4x)+(2x+{16}^{∘})+{94}^{∘} & ={360}^{∘} \\ (2x+2x-4x+2x)+({1}^{∘}+{14}^{∘}+{181}^{∘}+{16}^{∘}+{94}^{∘}) & ={360}^{∘} \\ 2x+{306}^{∘} & ={360}^{∘} \\ 2x & ={54}^{∘} \\ x & ={27}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,  the measure of the exterior angle of $∠A$ equals

$$
\begin{aligned}2x+{1}^{∘} & =2({27}^{∘})+{1}^{∘} \\  & ={55}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
